tool.name: List Samples from VCF/BCF URL
tool.description: Extract sample names from a remote VCF/BCF file using bcftools

param.name: vcf_url
param.label: VCF/BCF URL (http/https/ftp)
param.help: Provide a direct link to a .vcf.gz or .bcf file accessible from the Galaxy server.

tool.help:
This tool extracts **sample names** from a remote **VCF or BCF file** using `bcftools`.
Input ----- - A direct **URL** to a `.vcf.gz` or `.bcf` file accessible by the Galaxy server.
Output ------ - A text file containing the list of sample IDs present in the file.
Example ------- `bcftools query -l https://example.com/data/sample.vcf.gz`
